acceptance_criteria_coverage.ac_description: Users must be redirected to the Dashboard upon successful login.
Passwords must be masked during entry.
An error message must appear for invalid credentials.
The system must prevent "Brute Force" attacks.

identified_coverage_gaps.description: Toggle visibility for password field is not validated.
identified_coverage_gaps.recommended_test_scenario: Create a test that clicks the 'show/hide password' toggle and verifies that the password characters become visible and then masked again.

identified_coverage_gaps.description: Audit log recording of lockout events is not covered.
identified_coverage_gaps.recommended_test_scenario: After triggering account lockout, query the security audit log to confirm that a lockout event entry is created with correct user ID and timestamp.

identified_coverage_gaps.description: Verification of lockout duration or reset mechanism is absent.
identified_coverage_gaps.recommended_test_scenario: Attempt login after lockout period expires (or after invoking a reset) and verify that the account is unlocked and authentication succeeds.

qa_recommendations: Add the recommended test cases for password visibility toggle, audit‑log verification, and lockout duration to achieve full coverage of AC‑2 and AC‑4.
Prioritize execution of high‑risk security tests (TC-007 and the new lockout‑duration test) in every regression cycle.
Include automated checks for UI masking and toggle behavior in the smoke suite.
Integrate performance monitoring of login endpoint (TC-008) into continuous integration to catch regressions early.
